entity: Black vs white home-purchase mortgage denial rates, US, 2017
what_we_add: the lender-by-lender cut: about 2x at every 2017 home-purchase lender with 500+ Black and 2,000+ white applications
why: CFPB/FFIEC (2017 home purchase: Black applicants denied more) and Urban (2017 Black denial rate 2.0x white) match our direction and ratio. Only national totals, no lender cut. Urban's 1.2x 'real denial rate' is a different definition; Reveal's Santander ~3x predates the 2017 data release. Neither is a contradiction.
